resources.string: A local device-management tool. Android will ask you to approve device-admin access before the lock action is available.
Status: device-admin access is not enabled.
Allows this app to lock the device when the user presses the visible lock button.
This permission is required only for the visible “Lock this device” button. The app does not collect or transmit device data.
Privacy: this app has no network, SMS, call, camera, microphone, location, storage, accessibility, boot, or background-service permissions.
